Based on my search, here are the best places where you can order a birthday cake online:

## Top Online Birthday Cake Ordering Options

### **International/Nationwide Delivery**

| Platform | Best For | Key Features |
|----------|----------|--------------|
| **Bake Me a Wish** | Best overall nationwide service in the US | Large selection, personalized messages, kosher & gluten-free options, overnight shipping, no minimum order |
| **Goldbelly** | Famous bakery cakes from across the US | Cakes from iconic bakeries (Carlo's, Ovenly, etc.), filters for dietary needs (vegan, paleo, gluten-free, kosher) |
| **Milk Bar** | Trendy, modern cakes | Best-selling vanilla rainbow cake, nationwide delivery |

### **Regional/Country-Specific Services**

| Platform | Region | Highlights |
|----------|--------|------------|
| **IGP** | India & 100+ countries | Same-day delivery, 400+ Indian cities, photo cakes, pinata cakes, theme cakes |
| **FNP (Ferns N Petals)** | India, Malaysia & international | 2-hour delivery in 350+ cities, midnight delivery, eggless options, designer cakes |
| **Bakingo** | India | Same-day & 2-hour free delivery, 15+ flavors, fixed-time & midnight delivery options |
| **Flower Chimp** | Philippines | Ube cakes, rainbow cakes, Red Ribbon cakes, paired with flowers and gifts |
| **Habib Bakery** | Dubai & UAE | Same-day delivery, custom designer cakes, Galaxy Kunafa, Kinder Bueno cakes |
| **The Hummingbird Bakery** | London only | Colorful American-inspired cakes, rainbow piñata cake, personalization options |
| **Waitrose** | UK | Supermarket convenience, themed fondant cakes for kids, affordable (£13.50+) |

### **Specialty & Custom Options**

- **I Love Babycakes** (Hong Kong) – Homestyle flavors, baking classes, DIY kits
- **Vission Bakery** (Hong Kong) – Small-batch pastries, vegan/dairy-free options, custom orders
- **Brezze Gifts** (Philippines) – Filipino flavors like bibingka and mango cakes, same-day delivery

## What to Consider When Ordering

1. **Delivery speed** – Many offer same-day, next-day, or even 2-hour delivery
2. **Customization** – Photo cakes, personalized messages, theme designs
3. **Dietary restrictions** – Look for eggless, gluten-free, vegan, or kosher options
4. **Add-ons** – Flowers, chocolates, balloons, teddy bears
5. **Delivery area** – Confirm they deliver to your specific location
